name: Buildo
tagline: Describe a hardware idea and get a render, a parts cart with prices, starter firmware and assembly steps.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of Gemini API // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de l’API Gemini

problem: Beginners do not know which parts to buy or how to start a hardware project.
solution: Gemini turns an idea into a visualisation, a priced parts list, skeleton firmware and downloadable step-by-step instructions with a demo video.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for a soil sensor and get the full build package.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de l’API Gemini” among 260 submissions.
Outputs a complete build package, not just advice.

lessons: Return everything needed for the next step, including the shopping cart.
